Mode is compared to caller constant. binary-sha256 recomputes /proc/self/exe; each distinct executable must use its own approved digest.

CLI memory/time/disk/cpu exactly compared to permit. Supervisor JSON only validates individual memory/seconds/disk bounds and passes them to helper; never compares argv, permit or cpu. CPU is fixed4 in helper env and selected by native CLI affinity, no supervisor cpu-limit schema enforcement. Prepared tuples match but runtime equality needs an external check.
native/permit wall28800/14400; supervisor seconds28860/14460 are ONLY outer allowance, not extra native proving/verification time. This +60 relation is not enforced by run_limited.

--run-permit-sha256 is supplied externally, compared to SHA(file), not auto-derived by either entry/supervisor. No auto-generation/self-approval call found. However same command submitter can supply both bytes and pin; no signature or separate approver is technically enforced. User must independently approve exact bytes/SHA next round; no SHA approved now.

run_limited root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]; launch only from fixed root. cwd resolved against root, must stay below it; fresh_empty_cwd requires nonexistence then mkdir. Current proposal uses absolute artifact/anchor/manifest/permit paths and unused child cwd. Native verifier does not need data reads for metadata. Empty cwd is not a separate OS security principal.

Existing runner runs one arbitrary argv. Nonzero expected0 raises and records failure, but standalone verifier job knows nothing about prover exit, file provenance or artifact hash. An approved external gate must require actual prover exit0,no stop reason,new nonempty statement/proof,hashes recorded,expected X hash checked before dispatch. Do not run two commands independently or with a separator that ignores failure.

helper inherits os.environ; JSON env/unset fields are not used. Native calcInputLayer can accept ZKGPT_PUBLIC_EMBEDDING or RANDOM_INPUT_ABS. Verifier reads X from statement instead of an independent X pin. Preserve default input and unset overrides; compare generated statement X against approved signed64le hash before verifier.

Prover newDirectory rejects existing/outside-workspace target; verifier fresh cwd rejects existing. helper only asserts log absent, could overwrite time/run-record if those alone existed. Check all proposed files/dirs and symlinks before execution; current10 paths absent. Immutable helper writes NEW unique log/time/JSON entries under R6A, not the preparation directory; no old entry may change.

cpu-limit4 restricts native process to first4 available logical CPUs and sets ZKGPT_THREADS=4; helper OMP/OPENBLAS=4,allocator arenas2. Existing GKR has fixed32worker phases; this is4CPU affinity, not4OSthreads. Native code only requires >=1 available CPU; preparation probe explicitly confirmed4.
